name: Semantic Convention Compliance: orders
description: Measures how closely orders-demo telemetry follows the Weaver registry in weaver/model.

rules.name: order.total is numeric (double)
rules.description: Registry type for order.total is double; strings are non-compliant.

rules.name: order.payment_method uses registry enum values
rules.description: Must be credit_card, paypal or gift_card.

rules.name: No attributes outside the registry
rules.description: Stray attributes such as orderId are not defined in the registry.

rules.name: Only registry span names
rules.description: Every span from the service uses a registry-defined name.

rules.name: orders.checkout.count has string order.currency
rules.description: Metric attribute order.currency must be a valid string code.
